$comment: The official roster of TopoGym benchmarks: which families a named,
version-tagged benchmark contains, at which sizes, and which of them
are withheld from training. This file is the sole authority on
benchmark membership -- a registry entry that is not listed under some
benchmark version here is in no benchmark. Adding a family to
topogym/registry.py therefore never changes a published benchmark.
A version is a complete roster, not a diff on its predecessor, so a
later version may both add and remove families while earlier versions
stay exactly as they were published. Versions marked frozen are
immutable: their roster must keep matching the CSVs already shipped in
docs/splits/, which tests/test_splits.py enforces in both directions.
Family keys are matched against topogym.benchmarks.family_of by longest
prefix, so 'Shape' covers ShapeSq/ShapeCi/... and 'ChamberCount' wins
over 'Chambers' for ChamberCount4. A size of 0 means the family is not
size-parameterized: its builder fixes the geometry and it appears once.
"standalone" is the other half of that promise: families the
registry ships on purpose without any benchmark carrying them.
Listing one here is a deliberate act with a stated reason, so
that *forgetting* to declare a new family still fails loudly
while an intentional omission does not.

standalone.EpicChase: Chambers sit a full episode apart along one spiral corridor, so no single episode can reach the goal. It grades archive-based methods rather than policies, and scores incomparably to the graded families -- a stress test, kept out of every roster on purpose.
